product.title: Key West Mangrove Kayak Eco Tour

description.text: Paddle a kayak through mangrove creeks and shallow water on a Key West kayaking tour that offers an up-close look that this unique coastal environment. This guided tour is the perfect way to spot Florida wildlife in a natural habitat.Kayak tour of Key West mangroves Learn about local geology and nature Suited to all ages and skill levels Choice of morning or afternoon departure Dog Friendly Equipment, beverages, and local commentary are handled so you can focus on the water and island scenery. Ideal for travelers basing in Key West who want a guided Florida Keys experience without coordinating boats, gear, or launch times on their own.
